method: Manual tracing of visible exterior and party-wall boundaries, simplified and fitted separately within four approximate vector blocks. No generated infill. Annotated reproduction attributed to Sanborn, 1869; full original sheet provenance not yet verified. Coverage is partial; tiny outbuildings and ambiguous boundaries are omitted.
